## Learning Outcome



## Getting Started

### Installing and Loading the Required Libraries

Before getting started, let's install and load the required R packages into R environment. In this exercise, we need to install and load `tidyverse`.

| Package | Description |
|------------------------------------|------------------------------------|
| [tidyverse](https://www.tidyverse.org/) | A collection of R packages for data importing, cleaning, transformation, and visualisation (e.g., [readr](https://readr.tidyverse.org/), dplyr, tidyr, [ggplot2](https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/). |


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, readxl)
```
:::


### Importing Data

We import the exam data in csv format using the function [`read_scv()`](https://readr.tidyverse.org/reference/read_delim.html) from [**readr**](https://readr.tidyverse.org/) package, that is part of the **tidyverse** family.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
my_data <- read_excel("data/Superstore.xls")
knitr::kable(head(my_data))
```
